entities.name: Gérard Macé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gérard Macé is a French poet, essayist, translator and photographer. He published his first book Le jardin des langues in 1974 and since then has published nearly 50 books. His work is noted for its mixing of diverse genres. He has won many prizes including the Grand prix de poésie from the Academie Francaise for the entirety of his work.
